title: KodaCode Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the KodaCode CLI assistant (https://github.com/sageil/kodacode)

api_key.description: API key or bearer token. Supports environment variable expansion (e.g. ${OPENAI_API_KEY}). May be empty for local providers.

base_url.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. 'https://api.openai.com/v1'). Required for non-standard providers.

models.description: Static model definitions. Usually not needed — models are discovered automatically from the registry.

thinking_budget.description: Per-model reasoning token budget. Set to enable thinking/reasoning for this model. null (default) means no thinking support — reasoning_effort will not be sent to the provider.
Default thinking token budget for OAuth subscription requests (Anthropic only). Higher values give more reasoning time but increase latency. 0 uses provider default (10000). -1 disables thinking.

utility_model.description: Model for background tasks (title generation, compaction). Should be fast and cheap. Falls back to default_model if empty.

reviewer_model.description: Model for the reviewer subagent. Use a different capable model than the engineer for cross-model review. Falls back to the engineer's model if empty.

default_agent.description: Default agent ID for new sessions (e.g. 'engineer', 'default')

fallback_models.description: Ordered list of 'providerID/modelID' strings to try when the primary model fails all retries

compaction_threshold.description: Trigger compaction when token usage exceeds this fraction of the context window

compaction_keep_turns.description: Number of recent turns to preserve after compaction

prune_protect_tokens.description: Number of tokens at the end of history protected from pruning

prune_min_savings.description: Minimum token savings required for pruning to proceed

context_limit.description: Stop the tool loop when tokens exceed this fraction of the context window. Should be higher than compaction_threshold.

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for retryable API errors (429, 500, 502, 503)

tool_call_argument_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the model to finish emitting one tool call's JSON arguments before aborting the stream. This does not limit the tool execution itself.

engineer_review_limit.description: Maximum automatic engineer workflow retries before asking how to proceed. Applies to reviewer reruns and repeated stalled-task execution nudges.

background_auto_react.description: When true, the LLM is automatically re-prompted with results when a background bash task completes

snapshot.description: Enable per-turn git snapshots on a shadow branch. Creates lightweight commits after each turn that modifies files, enabling /replay time travel. Requires a git repository.

trace.description: Enable per-turn LLM step tracing and persistence for /trace. Disabled by default to avoid extra storage and UI overhead.

budget.description: Optional per-session spend cap in USD. 0 disables the limit.

budget_warn.description: Warn when session spend reaches this fraction of budget.

total_budget.description: Optional spend cap across all non-ephemeral sessions in the local database.

total_budget_warn.description: Warn when aggregate spend reaches this fraction of total_budget.

models.description: Per-model session configuration overrides. Keys are 'providerID/modelID'.

max_input_tokens.description: Override input token limit when the provider caps below the model's context window

tool_call_argument_timeout.description: Override the maximum seconds to wait for the model to finish emitting one tool call's JSON arguments before aborting the stream

port.description: TCP port to listen on. 0 means pick a random available port.

input_max_height.description: Maximum number of rows for the input textarea

display_turns.description: Number of recent turns to keep rendered in the TUI. 0 means unlimited.

auto_resume.description: Automatically load the most recent session on startup instead of showing the home screen

permission.description: Tool permission rules. Keys are tool names, values are permission rules.

oneOf.description: Apply this permission to all patterns for the tool
Pattern-specific permissions. Keys are glob patterns, values are 'allow', 'ask', or 'deny'.

log_prompts.description: Log full prompts sent to providers

instruction_files.description: Additional instruction files to include in the system prompt

max_instruction_size.description: Maximum size in bytes for instruction files. 0 means no limit.

tool_hints.description: Optional prompt-shaping hints for tools exposed by this MCP server. Keys are raw MCP tool names; use '*' for server-wide defaults.

summary.description: Short summary used in compact tool descriptions and the relevant-tools overlay.

guidance.description: Operator guidance for when this tool should be used.

triggers.description: Trigger phrases that should boost this tool for matching requests.

file_exts.description: Optional file extensions that make this tool more relevant (for example '.sql').

preserve_parameter_docs.description: Keep parameter descriptions in compact mode for this tool.

enabled.description: Whether the server is enabled. Default: true.

lsp.description: Language Server Protocol server configurations for code intelligence

servers.description: List of LSP servers. The correct server is selected based on file extension.

enabled.description: Whether the server is enabled. Default: true.

models.description: Per-model skill configuration. Keys are model IDs.

allow_all.description: Allow all skills for this model

deny.description: Skills to deny for this model

model_refresh_interval.description: How often (in days) to re-fetch model metadata from the upstream registry. 0 disables automatic refresh.

allowed_paths.description: Directories the sandbox allows read access to without prompting, even outside the project directory. ~/.config/kodacode/ is always included.

ignore_patterns.description: Glob patterns for directories/files tools should skip when scanning. Uses doublestar syntax. Merged with built-in defaults (node_modules, .git, __pycache__, etc.).
